answer_1.quote: We define the task of spoken-only language translation as translating an IPA sentence from a spoken-only low-resource language into a written high-resource language.
answer_1.outputs: translated high-resource language text from IPA-transcribed spoken-only language input

answer_2.quote: We use BLEU , chrF (including chrF++)  and SBERT-score . for evaluation.

answer_4.quote: To evaluate the effectiveness of our framework, we conduct an experiment comparing the performance of our UNILANG, human , and a combination of both.
answer_4.guideline: Humans are provided with 5 Zh-Bai audio pairs as reference examples to perform the translation task. The combined setting allows humans to revise translations generated by the LLMs.
